questions.explanation: This sign warns you not to enter. The road ahead is one-way, and you are approaching from the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead. Be prepared to watch for them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: You may make left turns.
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you of construction or maintenance work ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed at this location.

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface becomes very slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be near or on the road ahead. Drive slowly and carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow or stop
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it signals that they are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This could cause a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells drivers what they must do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right turns are not permitted.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign is a law you must obey. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection pass first. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and vehicles crossing. Wait until it is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for yellow, red, or green lights and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Green, yellow, and red.
questions.explanation: Traffic light colors from bottom to top are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop and let other traffic pass. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn permitted.
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.

Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe.

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.

questions.explanation: In this lane, you must either turn right or go straight. You cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe. This helps incoming traffic enter the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down and let trains pass. Trains cannot stop for you.
